title: Mindful Monday: 20-minute reset
summary: A short guided session to start the week calmly. Cameras optional.
body: A 20-minute guided breathing and stretching session, led by Grace Liu. Cameras optional. Join from the calendar invite.

title: Benefits office hours
summary: Drop in with questions about open enrollment and the new Meridian Plus plan.
body: Not sure which plan to pick for 2027? Drop in any time. Priya and the People team will be there with laptops to walk through the options.
location: Austin HQ, 3rd floor kitchen and online

title: Q4 all-hands
summary: Q3 results, Tidemark 4 trials, the new expense tool and your questions.
body:
Dana and the leadership team share Q3 results and the plan for Q4, followed by open questions. Send questions in advance to the internal comms team, anonymously if you like.

Tulsa and Rotterdam watch parties will have lunch.
location: Austin HQ, Main room, and streamed

title: Phishing awareness training
summary: Forty-five minutes on spotting and reporting phishing, with real examples.
body: Chloe Martin walks through real phishing emails sent to Meridian this year and how to spot them. Counts toward your annual security training.

title: Lunch and learn: inside Tidemark 4
summary: Hannah Kowalski on the radio, the battery and the leak detection in our next meter.
body: Hannah Kowalski and the firmware team show how Tidemark 4 lasts 20 years on one battery and what we are measuring in the field trials. Lunch provided in Denver.
location: Denver office, Big Thompson room, and online

title: Tulsa plant family day
summary: Tours of the line, a food truck and a bouncy castle. Families welcome.
body: Bring your family to see where Tidemark meters are made. Guided tours every half hour, a food truck, games and a bouncy castle. Closed-toe shoes for the tour.

title: Manager essentials workshop
summary: For new and current people managers: one-to-ones, feedback and the pay review.
body: A hands-on afternoon for people managers, run by Grace Liu: running good one-to-ones, giving feedback and preparing for the 2027 pay review.

title: Volunteer day at the food bank
summary: Sort and pack food for families before the holidays. Counts as a paid volunteer day.
body: Join us for a morning of sorting and packing at the food bank. Counts as one of your two paid volunteer days. Denver and Tulsa teams have their own local events the same week.

title: Diwali potluck
summary: Bring a dish to share and celebrate the festival of lights together.
body: Bring a dish to share, or just bring yourself. Organised by the Meridian Asian employee network. Diyas and rangoli supplies provided.

title: Year-end celebration
summary: Dinner and a party in every office to close out the year.
body: Every office has its own party: dinner, music and the Meridian awards. Partners and spouses welcome. Details by office in November.
